authority: This overlay is AUTHORITATIVE for interpreting round 1. It never asserts that the original bytes were different: the originals are preserved verbatim and hash-locked below, mistakes included. Where the two disagree, the original records what was done and this overlay records what that evidence may legitimately support.

noncanonical_status_label.label: NO_ENROLLMENT_DECISION_REACHED
noncanonical_status_label.statement: NO_ENROLLMENT_DECISION_REACHED is a RECONNAISSANCE label, not a protocol disposition. It is deliberately outside the twelve codes defined by cohort protocol v1.0/v1.1 so it can never be mistaken for a screening decision.

canonical_pending_rule: PENDING_OFFICIAL_DATE_UNAVAILABLE may be used canonically only when an actual candidate identity exists -- ticker AND fiscal period -- so the screening-log schema can be satisfied without inventing a label. Round 1 established no such identity for any ticker.

rules: The submissions index is an official SEC endpoint but is only filing METADATA.
A specific issuer-filed 8-K becomes a permitted source only after the exact filing is opened and is found to state the future earnings date and timing explicitly.
An accession number, a filing date, or an Item 2.02 label establishes NO upcoming candidate.
No previous filing metadata may influence enrollment.
NO FILING CONTENT WAS OPENED IN ROUND 1.

recent_8k_metadata.future_guidance: Future sweeps should not store recent-8-K lists when no candidate filing is opened.
